fix_commit.message: Fix a bug in the NOT NULL/IS NULL optimization of check-in [cb94350185f555c3] that can cause invalid data to be used for a column if that column has a CHECK constraint that includes the NOT NULL or IS NULL operator.
fix_commit.author: drh

findings.title: IS NULL/NOT NULL typeof-only optimization applied to reused (non-temp) column register, allowing stale placeholder data to be treated as real content
findings.message:
sqlite3ExprIfTrue()/sqlite3ExprIfFalse() code the IS NULL / IS NOT NULL operators by evaluating the operand into register r1 via sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(), then unconditionally call sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn(v, r1). That helper (added in the same commit, src/vdbeaux.c) sets OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG on the immediately preceding OP_Column opcode if it targets r1, telling the VDBE that only the 'type' of the value is needed so it may skip loading large TEXT/BLOB content from overflow pages. When content is on overflow pages, OP_Column honors this flag (src/vdbe.c, OP_Column handler) by pointing the result Mem's z pointer at the global 256-byte array sqlite3CtypeMap[] while still setting Mem.n to the column's true (potentially much larger) declared length, since the real bytes are never meant to be read.

The bug is that sqlite3ExprCodeTemp() does not always allocate a fresh temporary register: when the operand is already a table column that is cached/reused elsewhere (e.g. the same column is later referenced by a CHECK constraint on that table), it can return r1 == the column's existing cache register with regFree1 == 0, meaning the register is NOT a disposable temp and its OP_Column instruction/result may be referenced again later for the column's real value. The code still unconditionally applied sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn(v, r1) in this case, permanently marking the shared OP_Column with OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG. Consequently, when that same cached register was subsequently reused to obtain the actual column value (for example while evaluating a CHECK constraint containing NOT NULL/IS NULL on that column), the VDBE would deliver a Mem whose data pointer still referenced sqlite3CtypeMap with Mem.n set to the real (large) blob/string length rather than the genuine column bytes. Any later code path that treats this Mem as real content (e.g. OP_MakeRecord's memcpy(zPayload, pRec->z, pRec->n)) reads up to pRec->n bytes starting at the 256-byte sqlite3CtypeMap array -- an out-of-bounds read of adjacent process memory whose bytes are then copied into a database record, and invalid/incorrect data is used for the column.
findings.suggestion: Only apply the typeof-only optimization (sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn) when the operand register r1 is a genuine disposable temporary allocated specifically for this IS NULL/NOT NULL test, i.e. when regFree1 is non-zero (and equals r1). If regFree1==0, the register is shared/cached and may later be read for its real value, so the preceding OP_Column must not be marked OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG.

ground_truth.root_cause: The 2022 'skip loading large TEXT/BLOB column content for IS NULL/NOT NULL checks' optimization tagged the preceding OP_Column opcode with OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG based solely on which register held the operand, without distinguishing a disposable temporary register (safe to taint) from a shared/cached column register that could be read again later for its genuine value (e.g. by a CHECK constraint referencing the same column). This conflated two different lifetimes of the same register number.
